ToolDefinition.Name: Execute Clang-Tidy static analysis
ToolDefinition.Hint: Execute Clang-Tidy to perform static analysis on the project
ToolDefinition.Description: Uses project-wide settings from .clang-tidy to check code quality metrics (function size, dead code, loop pitfalls), security rules (insecure APIs, buffer overflows, memory issues, non-reentrant calls), and best practices (magic numbers, const correctness, initialization, macro safety, heap allocation). Run the 'Initialize Clang-Tidy analysis configuration' tool first to generate the configuration file.
